shortDescription: Manage users on the PowerScale Storage System

options.name: access_zone
options.description: This option mentions the zone in which a user is created. For creation, I(access_zone) acts as an attribute for the user. For all other operations I(access_zone) acts as a filter.

options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: api_user
options.description: username of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: email
options.description: The email id of the user can be added using email option. The email id can be set at the time of creation and modified later.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Enabled is a bool variable which is used to enable or disable the user account.

options.name: full_name
options.description: The additional information about the user can be provided using full_name option.

options.name: home_directory
options.description: The path specified in this option acts as a home directory for the user. The directory which is given should not be already in use. For a user in a system access zone, the absolute path has to be given. For users in a non-system access zone, the path relative to the non-system Access Zone's base directory has to be given.

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: password
options.description: The password for the user account. Required only in the creation of a user account. If given in other operations then the password will be ignored.

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: primary_group
options.description: A user can be member of multiple groups of which one group has to be assigned as primary group. This group will be used for access checks and can also be used when creating files. A user can be added to the group using Group Name.

options.name: provider_type
options.description: This option defines the type which will be used to authenticate the user. Creation, Modification and Deletion is allowed for local users. Adding and removing roles is allowed for all users of the system access zone. Getting user details is allowed for all users. If the I(provider_type) is 'ads' then domain name of the Active Directory Server has to be mentioned in the I(user_name). The format for the I(user_name) should be 'DOMAIN_NAME\user_name' or "DOMAIN_NAME\\user_name". This option acts as

options.name: role_name
options.description: The name of the role which a user will be assigned. User can be added to multiple roles.

options.name: role_state
options.description: The I(role_state) option is used to mention the existence of the role for a particular user. It is required when a role is added or removed from user.

options.name: shell
options.description: This option is for choosing the type of shell for the user account.

options.name: state
options.description: The state option is used to mention the existence of the user account.

options.name: update_password
options.description: This parameter controls the way the I(password) is updated during the creation and modification of a user. C(always) will update password for each execution. C(on_create) will only set while creating a user. For modifying I(password), set the I(update_password) to C(always).

options.name: user_id
options.description: The I(user_id) is auto generated or can be assigned at the time of creation. For all other operations either I(user_name) or I(user_id) is needed.

options.name: user_name
options.description: The name of the user account.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
